description: The user-edited kill-switch card keeps its state and the runbook id, but the rest of the user's note is rewritten away: 'during an incident use the Orbit console toggle, not the API' is lost.

mutations.text: Every flag needs a kill switch that turns it off within 1 minute. Tested in staging before canary and recorded in the rollout tool: a flag without a tested kill switch cannot enter canary. Anyone on the owning team may use it without approval. Turning the flag back on restarts the rollout from the internal stage. My note: Runbook RB-12.
